title: Quiz: Graduated Security Model
limitations: Generated from concept pages; not yet reviewed by Luis.
Content may drift from source; verify against current main.

questions.scenario: In ALLOW_ALL mode, a tool tries to read .env. What happens?
questions.explanation: Bypass-immune paths are ALWAYS blocked regardless of permission mode.

options: Too many denials within a time window
questions.explanation: When denial_threshold denials occur within downgrade_window_seconds, the mode auto-downgrades.

questions.scenario: In PLAN_ONLY mode, what happens to a tool call?
questions.explanation: PLAN_ONLY mode generates plans but requires explicit approval for any execution.

questions.scenario: What is the difference between ASK_ALL and AUTO_DENY_UNSAFE for a HIGH-risk tool?
options: ASK_ALL offers approval; AUTO_DENY_UNSAFE auto-denies without offering approval
questions.explanation: ASK_ALL always offers human approval. AUTO_DENY_UNSAFE auto-denies high-risk without asking.

questions.scenario: How many permission modes does Cogentrex implement?
questions.explanation: Seven modes: ALLOW_ALL, AUTO_APPROVE_SAFE, ASK_UNKNOWN, ASK_ALL, AUTO_DENY_UNSAFE, DENY_ALL, PLAN_ONLY.
